Column changes use container queries (@xl/main, @5xl/main), not viewport breakpoints.

layoutPatterns.name: Collapsible app sidebar
layoutPatterns.description: Sidebar 16rem wide that collapses to a 3rem icon-only rail; on phones it becomes an 18rem slide-over. Keyboard shortcut Cmd/Ctrl+B. Width animates over 200ms at constant speed. The header bar is 4rem tall and shrinks to 3rem when the sidebar is collapsed; it holds the toggle, a short vertical divider and a breadcrumb. Content area: 16px padding and 16px gaps, a row of three 16:9 tiles above one tall panel, all with 14px corners.
layoutPatterns.goodFor: apps with many sections where screen width matters
layoutPatterns.notes: ui/sidebar.tsx (SIDEBAR_WIDTH "16rem", SIDEBAR_WIDTH_ICON "3rem", SIDEBAR_WIDTH_MOBILE "18rem", shortcut "b", duration-200 ease-linear); blocks/sidebar-07/page.tsx.

layoutPatterns.name: Centred sign-in column on a muted page
layoutPatterns.description: Full-height page in the muted background colour with 24px padding (40px from tablet up). One centred column, max 24rem wide, 24px gaps: a small logo lockup (24px rounded square plus name) above a single form card.
layoutPatterns.goodFor: sign-in, sign-up, single-question forms
layoutPatterns.notes: blocks/login-03/page.tsx (min-h-svh, bg-muted, p-6 md:p-10, max-w-sm, gap-6).

layoutPatterns.name: Two-panel sign-in card
layoutPatterns.description: Same muted full-height page. One card, max 24rem on phones and 56rem from tablet up, with no inner padding and clipped corners, split into two equal columns: the form on one side (24px padding, 32px from tablet up; centred 24px bold title with a balanced subtitle; three equal social buttons in a row 16px apart) and an image filling the other side (hidden on phones).
layoutPatterns.goodFor: sign-in pages that want some brand imagery
layoutPatterns.notes: blocks/login-04/page.tsx and components/login-form.tsx (max-w-sm md:max-w-4xl, Card overflow-hidden p-0, grid md:grid-cols-2, image column "relative hidden bg-muted md:block").

layoutPatterns.name: Standard centred modal
layoutPatterns.description: Centred box, max 32rem wide on larger screens and the viewport minus 2rem on phones; 24px padding, 16px gaps, 10px corners, a border plus a large shadow; page behind dimmed with black at 50%. Appears with a 200ms fade and a slight zoom from 95%.
layoutPatterns.goodFor: confirmations, short forms
layoutPatterns.notes: ui/dialog.tsx (max-w-[calc(100%-2rem)] sm:max-w-lg, p-6, gap-4, rounded-lg, shadow-lg, overlay bg-black/50, duration-200, zoom-in-95).

layoutPatterns.name: Centred text hero with a pill announcement, then a feature grid
layoutPatterns.description: Hero section with modest padding on phones (24px top, 32px bottom) growing to 128px top and bottom on desktop. Everything centred in a column max 64rem wide with 16px gaps: a small pill link (muted fill, 14px medium text), a headline stepping 30 → 48 → 60 → 72px, a muted paragraph max 42rem wide at 20px, and two large buttons side by side 16px apart. Next section: lightly tinted band with 32 → 96px vertical padding, a centred intro max 58rem wide, then cards in 1 → 2 → 3 columns (max 64rem, 16px gaps). Each card is a bordered box with 8px padding around an inner 180px-tall panel with 24px padding: 48px icon at the top, bold title and short text at the bottom.
layoutPatterns.goodFor: product or project landing pages that lead with words
layoutPatterns.notes: shadcn-ui/taxonomy app/(marketing)/page.tsx (lg:py-32, max-w-[64rem], max-w-[42rem], max-w-[58rem], rounded-2xl pill, sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3).

layoutPatterns.name: Narrow hero with gradient headline and pill buttons
layoutPatterns.description: Centred column only 36rem wide with 20px side padding. Top to bottom: a fully rounded badge link; a bold headline at 36px (72px with 80px line-height from tablet up), letter-spacing −0.02em, lines balanced, the text itself filled with a diagonal black-to-warm-grey gradient; a grey paragraph (20px from tablet up) 24px below; two fully rounded buttons 20px apart (solid black that flips to white on hover; white with a grey border and medium shadow). Then, 40px lower, a three-column card grid (one column on phones) up to 80rem wide with 20px gaps. The pieces fade up 10px over 0.5s with start delays of 0.15s, 0.25s and 0.3s.
layoutPatterns.goodFor: launch pages, open-source project home pages
layoutPatterns.notes: steven-tey/precedent app/page.tsx and tailwind.config.js. The display font in the source is a local SF Pro file, which is not open-licensed — substitute one.

layoutPatterns.name: Tall marketing hero with light-weight display type
layoutPatterns.description: Hero block with 128px padding above and below (96px in the narrow variant). Display text runs 40px on phones, 56px from 768px and 64px from 1012px, set at an unusually light heading weight (about 425–440 on a variable font) with line-height 1.0–1.1 and, at the largest size, letter-spacing −0.035em.
layoutPatterns.goodFor: brand and marketing pages that should feel calm and expensive rather than loud
layoutPatterns.notes: @primer/brand-primitives functional/components/hero/base.css and functional/typography/typography-responsive.css.

layoutPatterns.name: One large tile with two smaller tiles beside it
layoutPatterns.description: A 6-column, 2-row grid with 16px gaps and 16px side and bottom padding, up to 96rem wide and never taller than the viewport minus 200px. The first tile spans 4 columns and both rows; the other two span 2 columns and one row each, stacked on the right. Every tile is a square. On phones the three stack in one column.
layoutPatterns.goodFor: shop home pages, featured work, any "hero item plus two more" opening
layoutPatterns.notes: vercel/commerce components/grid/three-items.tsx (md:grid-cols-6 md:grid-rows-2, md:col-span-4 md:row-span-2, md:col-span-2 md:row-span-1, aspect-square, max-w-(--breakpoint-2xl), lg:max-h-[calc(100vh-200px)]).

layoutPatterns.name: Navigation bar in three equal thirds
layoutPatterns.description: Bar with 16px padding (24px at the sides on desktop) divided into three equal thirds: left holds the logo, site name (uppercase, 14px medium) and text links 24px apart (14px, mid-grey, underlined on hover with a 4px gap); the middle holds a centred search box; the right holds the cart, aligned to the edge. On phones a menu button replaces the links.
layoutPatterns.goodFor: shops and content sites where search deserves the centre
layoutPatterns.notes: vercel/commerce components/layout/navbar/index.tsx (md:w-1/3 ×3, p-4 lg:px-6, gap-6 text-sm, underline-offset-4).

layoutPatterns.name: Auto-scrolling strip of square tiles
layoutPatterns.description: A single row that scrolls sideways, 16px gaps. Each tile is square, 30% of the viewport height but never more than 275px; two-thirds of the screen wide on phones and one-third from tablet up, capped at 475px. The item list is repeated three times so the loop never runs out.
layoutPatterns.goodFor: related items, galleries, logo rows
layoutPatterns.notes: vercel/commerce components/carousel.tsx (h-[30vh] max-h-[275px] w-2/3 max-w-[475px] md:w-1/3, animate-carousel, products tripled).

layoutPatterns.name: Bento feature grid
layoutPatterns.description: Three columns, every row exactly 22rem tall, 16px gaps; each card chooses how many columns it spans. Cards have 12px corners and the near-invisible ring-and-drop shadow, with a background illustration on top and an icon (48px), title (20px semibold) and short grey text at the bottom-left. On desktop hover the text block slides up 40px, the icon shrinks to 75% and a link row slides in from 40px below — all over 300ms.
layoutPatterns.goodFor: feature overviews, portfolio highlights
layoutPatterns.notes: magicuidesign/magicui apps/www/registry/magicui/bento-grid.tsx (auto-rows-[22rem] grid-cols-3 gap-4, rounded-xl, lg:group-hover:-translate-y-10, group-hover:scale-75, duration-300).

layoutPatterns.name: Endless marquee row
layoutPatterns.description: A row of items repeated four times end to end with 1rem gaps and 8px padding, sliding continuously on a 40-second loop. Options: pause while hovered, reverse direction, vertical.
layoutPatterns.goodFor: logo walls, testimonial rows
layoutPatterns.notes: apps/www/registry/magicui/marquee.tsx ([--duration:40s] [--gap:1rem], repeat = 4, group-hover:[animation-play-state:paused]).

layoutPatterns.name: Command palette window
layoutPatterns.description: Floating window max 640px wide with 12px corners, 8px inner padding, a 1px border and one large soft shadow. Search field at the top in 17px text with a line under it and 16px of space below. Results are rows 48px tall with 8px corners, 16px side padding, 4px between rows and 18px icons; the list is at most 400px tall and its height animates over 100ms as results change. Group headings are 12px grey. Keyboard hints sit at the right as 20px-high chips with 4px corners.
layoutPatterns.goodFor: search-first navigation, power-user actions
layoutPatterns.notes: pacocoursey/cmdk website/styles/cmdk/vercel.scss. Sibling files: linear.scss (8px corners, no outer padding, 18px input with 20px padding) and raycast.scss (rows 40px tall, 8px side padding).

layoutPatterns.name: Stacked toast notifications
layoutPatterns.description: Toasts 356px wide, 24px from the screen edge (16px on phones), with 8px corners, 16px padding and 13px text. Up to three show at once; when collapsed, each toast behind the front one is 5% smaller and shifted by one 14px gap so its edge peeks out; hovering expands the stack with 14px between toasts. Each disappears after 4 seconds.
layoutPatterns.goodFor: non-blocking confirmations and errors
layoutPatterns.notes: sonner dist/index.mjs (TOAST_WIDTH 356, GAP 14, VISIBLE_TOASTS_AMOUNT 3, VIEWPORT_OFFSET 24px, MOBILE_VIEWPORT_OFFSET 16px, TOAST_LIFETIME 4000) and dist/styles.css (--scale: var(--toasts-before) * 0.05 + 1). "Hovering expands" is how I read the data-expanded rules; I did not run it.

layoutPatterns.name: Bottom sheet over a shrunken page
layoutPatterns.description: A panel slides up from the bottom over 500ms on the iOS-style curve. At its top is a small grab handle, 32×5px, fully rounded, 70% opacity, with an invisible 44px touch area. Optionally the page behind shrinks slightly (by 26px of its width), moves down 14px and gets 8px corners so it looks like a card underneath. Letting go closes the sheet if it has been dragged past 25% or flicked faster than 0.4.
layoutPatterns.goodFor: phone-first menus, pickers and detail views
layoutPatterns.notes: vaul style.css and dist/index.mjs (WINDOW_TOP_OFFSET 26, BORDER_RADIUS 8, CLOSE_THRESHOLD 0.25, VELOCITY_THRESHOLD 0.4, NESTED_DISPLACEMENT 16; getScale = (innerWidth − 26) / innerWidth).

layoutPatterns.name: Small dialog set slightly above centre
layoutPatterns.description: Dialog 24rem wide (never closer than 1.5rem to the screen edges), 16px padding, 16px gaps, nudged 2rem above true centre. Title 16px bold on a 24px line; description 14px on a 20px line in grey; buttons right-aligned 12px apart, each 32px tall. Backdrop is black at only 20% (50% in dark mode).
layoutPatterns.goodFor: quiet confirmations in dense tools
layoutPatterns.notes: mui/base-ui docs dialog demo CSS module (width 24rem, max-width calc(100% - 3rem), margin-top -2rem).

layoutPatterns.name: Documentation shell
layoutPatterns.description: Fixed top bar 3.5rem tall (12px vertical, 16px horizontal padding). Left navigation sidebar 18.75rem (300px) wide. Reading column 45rem (720px) wide with 16px side padding. On narrow screens a 3rem "on this page" bar sits under the top bar; it disappears from 72rem up. Body line-height 1.75, headings 1.2.
layoutPatterns.goodFor: documentation, handbooks, knowledge bases
layoutPatterns.notes: @astrojs/starlight dist/style/props.css (--sl-nav-height, --sl-sidebar-width, --sl-content-width, --sl-mobile-toc-height). I did not read the width of the desktop right-hand contents column.

layoutPatterns.name: Large-type single reading column
layoutPatterns.description: One column 720px wide (never wider than the screen minus 2em) with 3em padding above and below. Body text is 20px at 1.7 line-height; headings step up by a 1.25 ratio to about 61px at 1.2 line-height. The page background is white with a soft blue-grey wash only across the top 600px.
layoutPatterns.goodFor: personal blogs, essays, simple marketing pages
layoutPatterns.notes: withastro/astro examples/blog/src/styles/global.css (main width 720px, max-width calc(100% - 2em), padding 3em 1em; background-size 100% 600px).

layoutPatterns.name: Narrow blog with a wavy active link
layoutPatterns.description: Content column 48rem wide, centred, with 16px side padding. The current page in the navigation is marked with a 2px wavy underline sitting 8px below the text. Keyboard focus is a 2px dashed outline in the accent colour. Jumping to an anchor leaves 1rem of space above it.
layoutPatterns.goodFor: writing-focused sites that want a little personality
layoutPatterns.notes: satnaing/astro-paper src/styles/global.css (max-w-3xl, "underline decoration-wavy decoration-2 underline-offset-8", outline-dashed, :target scroll-margin-block 1rem).

layoutPatterns.name: Article body rhythm
layoutPatterns.description: Text measure capped at 65 characters. 16px text on a 28px line; paragraphs 20px apart. Second-level headings get 48px above and 24px below; third-level 32px above and 12px below. Lists are indented 26px with 8px between items. Images and quotes get 32px margins; horizontal rules 48px. Quotes are italic with a 4px bar on the left. Links are underlined at weight 500.
layoutPatterns.goodFor: articles, docs pages, long descriptions
layoutPatterns.notes: @tailwindcss/typography src/styles.js "base" variant (px values are the numerators of its em() calls).

layoutPatterns.name: Fixed-width page with fraction columns
layoutPatterns.description: Page width 960px with 30px gutters. Columns come only in simple fractions: one-quarter, one-third, one-half, two-thirds, three-quarters, full. All spacing is in 5px steps and shrinks one or two steps on phones. Nothing is rounded.
layoutPatterns.goodFor: forms, step-by-step services, anything where clarity beats style
layoutPatterns.notes: govuk-frontend dist/govuk/settings/_measurements.scss ($govuk-page-width 960px, $govuk-gutter 30px, $govuk-grid-widths) and _spacing.scss.

layoutPatterns.name: 4 / 8 / 16-column grid
layoutPatterns.description: Column count doubles with screen size: 4 columns from 320px with no side margin, 8 columns from 672px with 16px margins, 16 columns from 1056px and 1312px with 16px margins, and 16 columns from 1584px with 24px margins. Everything snaps to an 8px unit.
layoutPatterns.goodFor: data-heavy products that need strict alignment
layoutPatterns.notes: @carbon/layout src/index.ts breakpoints (sm 320, md 672, lg 1056, xlg 1312, max 1584) and miniUnit 8.

layoutPatterns.name: Four container widths and four section spacings
layoutPatterns.description: Content containers come in four fixed widths: 448, 688, 880 and 1136px. Page sections get 24, 40, 64 or 80px of space above and below. One global multiplier (90–110%) scales all of it together.
layoutPatterns.goodFor: picking page width and vertical rhythm as two simple choices
layoutPatterns.notes: @radix-ui/themes src/components/container.css (--container-1…4) and section.css; tokens/scaling.css.

layoutPatterns.name: Widths measured in characters
layoutPatterns.description: Body text blocks are capped at 45 or 60 characters wide; headings are capped much narrower so they wrap into balanced lines: 20 characters for h1, 25 for h2, 35 for h3 and below.
layoutPatterns.goodFor: text-led pages; keeps headlines from running in one long line
layoutPatterns.notes: open-props src/props.sizes.css (--size-content-2 45ch, --size-content-3 60ch, --size-header-1/2/3 20/25/35ch) and src/extra/normalize.src.css.

microDetails.rule: Keyboard focus = the border turns the ring colour and a 3px ring appears in that colour at 50% opacity; the browser outline is removed.
microDetails.css: outline-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50  /* Tailwind classes, ui/button.tsx and ui/input.tsx */

microDetails.rule: Keyboard focus = 2px solid outline in step 8 of the accent scale, 2px away from solid buttons but inset by 1px on soft, outline and card surfaces.
microDetails.css: outline: 2px solid var(--focus-8); outline-offset: 2px; /* -1px on soft/outline/surface variants and cards */

microDetails.rule: Focus outline is 2px wide and drawn 2px inside the element so it never overflows its container.
Focused links get a solid yellow background, black text and a 4px black bar underneath — no ring at all.
microDetails.css: outline: 3px solid transparent; color: #0b0c0c; background-color: #ffdd00; box-shadow: 0 -2px #ffdd00, 0 4px #0b0c0c;
microDetails.notes: helpers/_focused.scss govuk-focused-text with functional colours resolved (focus = yellow #ffdd00, focus-text = black #0b0c0c).

microDetails.rule: Focused inputs get a 3px yellow outline flush to the edge and their 2px black border doubles to 4px via an inset shadow, so the box does not change size.

A focused primary button gets a 1px line in the focus colour at its very edge and a 1px line in the page background just inside it — a ring drawn entirely inside the button, so nothing shifts or overflows.
microDetails.notes: @carbon/styles@1.119.0 css/styles.min.css .cds--btn--primary:focus (the --cds-button-focus-color wrapper variable omitted).

microDetails.rule: Focus ring is 3px wide, sits 2px outside the element and animates in from 8px wide.
microDetails.notes: tokens/_md-comp-focus-ring.scss: width 3px, outward-offset 2px, active-width 8px. I did not read the duration value.

microDetails.rule: The focus outline starts tight and eases out to 5px away from the element over 145ms, drawing the eye to where focus landed.
Focus is shown with a 2px dashed outline in the accent colour, 1px away from the element.
microDetails.css: outline-accent outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-dashed  /* Tailwind classes */

microDetails.rule: Buttons shrink to 97% while pressed, over 160ms with ease-out.
microDetails.css: button { transition: transform 160ms ease-out; } button:active { transform: scale(0.97); }
microDetails.notes: HeroUI does the same: data-[pressed=true]:scale-[0.97] (@heroui/theme).

microDetails.rule: Buttons shrink to 96% on press; never go below 95% because it looks exaggerated.
microDetails.notes: Disagrees slightly with the 0.97 used by Emil Kowalski and HeroUI.

microDetails.rule: The "classic" button darkens on press with a filter instead of changing colour: 92% brightness and 110% saturation in light mode, 108% brightness in dark mode.
Buttons have a solid 2px bottom edge and move down 2px when pressed, like a physical key.
Hover on a filled button is the same colour at 90% opacity (secondary buttons 80%) rather than a separate hover colour.
Hover effects switch on in 40ms and fade back over 120ms, so the interface feels instant but never flickers.
Hover styles are wrapped so they apply only on devices that can really hover; touch screens never get stuck hover states.
microDetails.notes: Base UI demos do the same.

microDetails.rule: Interaction states are a translucent overlay of the content colour: 8% on hover, 12% on focus, 12% when pressed, 16% while dragged.
microDetails.notes: tokens/versions/v0_192/_md-sys-state.scss.

microDetails.rule: Buttons, checkboxes, switches and menu items keep the normal arrow cursor; only links get the pointing hand.
microDetails.notes: Mantine's default theme agrees (cursorType: "default"). AstroPaper does the opposite and sets cursor: pointer on every enabled button.

microDetails.rule: Disabled controls are shown at 50% opacity and ignore the pointer.
microDetails.notes: HeroUI also uses 0.5 (disabledOpacity). Radix Themes instead uses fixed greys: text gray-a8 on a gray-a3 fill.

microDetails.rule: Letter-spacing is set per size: +0.0025em at 12px, 0 at 14–16px, then steadily tighter to −0.01em at 35px and −0.025em at 60px.
Text from 36px upward gets −0.02em letter-spacing; smaller text is left alone.
microDetails.notes: @park-ui/panda-preset textStyles 4xl–7xl. Primer Brand goes further at 64px: −0.035em. Precedent's hero uses −0.02em. Material 3 does the reverse for small text, adding +0.5px at 12px labels.

microDetails.rule: Heading weight drops as size rises: 600 at 14–16px, 400 at 20–32px, 300 at 42px and above.
microDetails.notes: @carbon/type scss/_styles.scss heading-01…07. Primer Brand does similar with variable weights (480 down to 425). Tailwind Typography does the opposite (h3 600, h2 700, h1 800).

microDetails.rule: Headings wrap into lines of even length; body text avoids leaving a single word on the last line.
microDetails.css: h1, h2, h3 { text-wrap: balance; } p { text-wrap: pretty; }
microDetails.notes: balance on headings: open-props normalize.src.css, Precedent hero, shadcn tooltip/login text. "pretty" for body is from Jakub Krehel's typography.md.

microDetails.rule: Text is rendered with grayscale antialiasing so it looks thinner and crisper on macOS.
microDetails.notes: Also on Taxonomy's body (antialiased), Mantine (fontSmoothing: true) and recommended in Jakub Krehel's skill.

microDetails.rule: Numbers that change or sit in columns use fixed-width digits so nothing jiggles.
microDetails.notes: shadcn dashboard stat cards (tabular-nums); a MUST in vercel-labs/web-interface-guidelines AGENTS.md; also in Jakub Krehel's skill.

microDetails.rule: Inline code is set at 95% of the surrounding text size with −0.007em letter-spacing and padding of 0.1em top and bottom, 0.25em at the sides.
Emphasis and quotes switch to an italic serif, enlarged to 118% and tightened by −0.025em so it sits evenly beside the sans text.
Form fields use 16px text on phones (so iOS does not zoom in) and 14px on larger screens.
microDetails.notes: ui/input.tsx. Same rule as a MUST in web-interface-guidelines; the Astro blog example also sets inputs to 16px.

microDetails.rule: Long-form text is never wider than 65 characters; links are underlined at weight 500, bold text is 600, and block quotes are italic with a 4px bar.
microDetails.notes: src/styles.js DEFAULT block.

microDetails.rule: Link underlines are thin (1px) and sit slightly below the text (offset 0.1578em); on hover the underline thickens to 3px.
microDetails.css: text-decoration-thickness: max(1px, .0625rem); text-underline-offset: 0.1578em; /* hover */ text-decoration-thickness: max(3px, .1875rem, .12em);
microDetails.notes: settings/_links.scss variables; the property names are my mapping of those variables.

microDetails.rule: Text links show no underline until hover, and the underline then sits 4px below the text.
microDetails.notes: ui/button.tsx "link" variant; Vercel Commerce nav links use the same offset.

microDetails.rule: Headings use tighter line-heights than body text of the same size: 18, 22, 24, 26px for 14, 16, 18, 20px headings versus 20, 24, 26, 28px for body.
In dark mode, borders are white at 10% opacity and input borders white at 15%, instead of fixed greys, so they work on any dark surface.
microDetails.notes: apps/v4/registry/themes.ts dark blocks. HeroUI uses 15% both ways: rgba(17,17,17,0.15) light, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) dark.

microDetails.rule: The "muted" border is the default border colour at 70% opacity, not a second colour.
Every elevation level starts with a 1px ring (spread-only shadow) in a translucent grey, then adds blur layers; the ring keeps edges crisp on any background.
microDetails.notes: Recurs in Primer (0 0 0 1px …), Park UI (0 0 1px gray.a7), HeroUI (0 0 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3)), Magic UI and Jakub Krehel's "shadow as border".

microDetails.rule: A 1px inset shadow is used in place of a border when the border may appear or disappear, so the element never changes size.
microDetails.notes: dist/css/functional/size/border.css, with var(--borderWidth-thin/thick) resolved to their rem values.

microDetails.rule: In dark mode, drop the layered shadows and keep only a 1px white ring at 8% (13% on hover) — blur shadows are invisible on dark backgrounds.
microDetails.notes: HeroUI and Radix Themes disagree: they keep drop shadows in dark mode and make them several times stronger.

microDetails.rule: Inset surfaces get a half-pixel light line on the bottom edge and a half-pixel dark line on the top edge to fake a bevel.
The "classic" button is built from five inset shadows (dark hairline, 2px dark base, accent hairline, two white highlights at the top) over a subtle vertical gradient — a soft 3D look without images.
microDetails.css: box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--gray-a4), inset 0 -2px 1px var(--gray-a3), inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent-9), inset 0 4px 2px -2px var(--white-a9), inset 0 2px 1px -1px var(--white-a9);
microDetails.notes: components/_internal/base-button.css, light-mode tokens substituted into the classic variant rule.

microDetails.rule: When a rounded box sits inside another, outer radius = inner radius + the padding between them (e.g. 12px inner with 8px padding → 20px outer). Beyond about 24px of padding, treat them as unrelated.
microDetails.notes: surfaces.md. web-interface-guidelines says the same ("nested radii: child ≤ parent; concentric").

microDetails.rule: Images get a 1px outline of pure black at 10% (pure white at 10% in dark mode) so their edges stay defined against any background.
microDetails.notes: surfaces.md, verbatim (the −1px offset keeps the outline inside the image so it adds nothing to layout). The file insists on pure black/white, never a tinted near-black.

microDetails.rule: Floating panels can be translucent: white at 70% with a very heavy 64px backdrop blur; form-control surfaces (text fields, selects, checkboxes) use white at 85%.
Apple-style glass bar: white at 60%, 20px backdrop blur with saturation boosted to 180%, and a brighter 1px top edge (white at 40%) as if catching light.
microDetails.css: .toolbar { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%); border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4); }
microDetails.notes: skills/apple-design/SKILL.md — a third-party description of the look, not Apple code.

microDetails.rule: The page behind a modal is dimmed with black at 50%.
microDetails.notes: The systems disagree: Radix Themes uses 40% light / 60% dark (--color-overlay: black-a6 / black-a8); Base UI demos use 20% light / 50% dark.

microDetails.rule: Stat cards carry a bottom-to-top gradient from the accent colour at 5% into the plain card colour — just enough to stop them looking flat.
microDetails.notes: blocks/dashboard-01/components/section-cards.tsx.

microDetails.rule: Selected text is highlighted with step 5 of the translucent accent scale rather than the browser blue.
Each theme has two on/off switches: "depth" adds a short colour-tinted shadow and a 0.5px text shadow to buttons; "noise" adds a grain texture. Flat themes set both to 0.
microDetails.notes: theme/*.css and components/button.css. Of the 25 themes read, depth is on in light, dark, cupcake, silk, caramellatte, luxury, abyss and autumn; noise is on only in caramellatte.

microDetails.rule: Shadows are tinted toward the page's own hue (blue-grey 96,115,159) instead of pure black.
microDetails.notes: Same idea: Primer light shadows use #25292e / #1f2328, tweakcn Elegant Luxury uses hsl(0 63% 18%), daisyUI tints with the button colour. web-interface-guidelines: "tint borders/shadows/text toward bg hue".

microDetails.rule: Button heights: 24px (xs), 32px (sm), 36px (default), 40px (lg). Inputs are 36px to match the default button.
microDetails.notes: ui/button.tsx, ui/input.tsx. Others: Radix Themes 24/32/40/48px; Primer 28/32/40px; Carbon 24/32/40/48/64/80px; Material 3 filled button 40px; Base UI demo buttons 32px.

microDetails.rule: Button side padding grows with height: 8px at 24px tall, 12px at 32px, 16px at 40px, 24px at 48px; corner radius steps up at each size too (3, 4, 6, 8px).
microDetails.notes: components/button.css and _internal/base-button.css. Button text is weight 500.

microDetails.rule: Cards use one number for everything: 24px padding, 24px between sections, 14px corners, 1px border and the smallest shadow.
microDetails.css: flex flex-col gap-6 rounded-xl border bg-card py-6 text-card-foreground shadow-sm
microDetails.notes: ui/card.tsx; header/content add px-6.

microDetails.rule: Tooltips invert the page colours (text colour as background), with 12px text and 12px × 6px padding.
microDetails.css: rounded-md bg-foreground px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-balance text-background
microDetails.notes: ui/tooltip.tsx.

microDetails.rule: Dropdown menus are at least 8rem wide with 4px inner padding, the control radius, a border and a medium shadow.
microDetails.css: min-w-[8rem] rounded-md border bg-popover p-1 shadow-md
microDetails.notes: ui/dropdown-menu.tsx.

microDetails.rule: A control that looks small (a 32×5px drag handle) still gets an invisible touch target of at least 44×44px.
microDetails.css: width: max(100%, 2.75rem); height: max(100%, 2.75rem); position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
microDetails.notes: vaul style.css [data-vaul-handle-hitarea]. web-interface-guidelines: hit target ≥24px, ≥44px on mobile. Jakub Krehel: 44px touch, at least 40px on dense desktop.

microDetails.rule: Keyboard-shortcut hints are 20px-high chips with 4px corners, 4px padding and 12px uppercase text on a light grey fill.
microDetails.css: kbd { font-size: 12px; min-width: 20px; padding: 4px; height: 20px; border-radius: 4px; text-transform: uppercase; }
microDetails.notes: website/styles/cmdk/vercel.scss.

microDetails.rule: Depth is limited to six fixed levels: 0, 1, 3, 6, 8 and 12 (density-independent pixels).
microDetails.notes: tokens/versions/v0_192/_md-sys-elevation.scss.

microDetails.rule: One multiplier (0.9, 0.95, 1, 1.05 or 1.1) scales every space, font size, line-height and radius together, giving compact or roomy versions of the same design.
All corner sizes derive from one base radius by fixed multipliers: ×0.6, ×0.8, ×1, ×1.4, ×1.8, ×2.2, ×2.6.
microDetails.notes: apps/v4/app/globals.css.

microDetails.rule: A theme can carry its own global letter-spacing and spacing unit, e.g. −0.025em with a 0.27rem unit (Violet Bloom) or +0.025em (Supabase); the default is 0em and 0.25rem.
microDetails.notes: utils/theme-presets.ts; defaults in config/theme.ts.

microDetails.rule: Popups appear from 97% scale with a 4px slide, never from zero.
microDetails.css: @keyframes rt-slide-from-top { from { transform: translateY(4px) scale(0.97); } to { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); } }
microDetails.notes: Same idea elsewhere: shadcn zoom-in-95 (0.95), Base UI demos 0.98, Carbon popover 0.96, Primer Brand 0.96. Emil Kowalski: start at 0.9 or higher (0.95 in his example); Jakub Krehel uses 0.25 but only for small icons swapping.

microDetails.rule: Closing is quicker than opening: popovers 160ms in / 100ms out, dialogs 200ms in / 100ms out.
microDetails.notes: components/animations.css, _internal/base-dialog.css. Primer: enter 300ms / exit 200ms. Park UI: in 250–400ms / out 200ms. Jakub Krehel: enter 300ms / exit 150ms.

microDetails.rule: Content enters by fading in while moving up 12px and sharpening from a 4px blur; it leaves by moving only 12px and taking half the time.
microDetails.css: .item { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); filter: blur(4px); animation: fadeInUp 400ms ease-out forwards; }
microDetails.notes: animations.md. Magic UI blur-fade is the same idea with 6px offset, 6px blur, 0.4s.

microDetails.rule: When several items appear in sequence, delay each by 30–80ms; longer makes the page feel slow.
microDetails.notes: Sources disagree: Jakub Krehel suggests about 100ms between groups (80ms between words of a title); Precedent's hero uses delays of 0.15s, 0.25s and 0.3s.

microDetails.rule: Never write "transition: all"; list the properties, and animate only transform and opacity, never width, height, top or left.
microDetails.notes: AGENTS.md Animation section; same rule in Emil Kowalski's skill (the example value is his).

microDetails.rule: Popup animations exist only inside a "no-preference" motion query, so people who ask for reduced motion get none by default.
Duration can be computed from how far and how large the moving thing is: distance × 0.5 + width × 0.35 + height × 0.3, in milliseconds.
microDetails.notes: open-props durations.min.css.

microDetails.rule: For destructive actions, a hold-to-confirm fill takes 2 seconds at constant speed while held and snaps back in 200ms on release.
microDetails.css: .overlay { clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0); transition: clip-path 200ms ease-out; } .button:active .overlay { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); transition: clip-path 2s linear; }

microDetails.rule: Scrolling to the end of a popup list must not scroll the page behind it, and off-screen rows skip rendering work.
microDetails.notes: website/styles/cmdk/*.scss. web-interface-guidelines makes overscroll-behavior: contain a MUST for modals and drawers.

microDetails.rule: A bottom sheet extends an invisible copy of its background 200% below itself, so dragging it upward past its resting point never reveals a gap.
microDetails.css: [data-vaul-drawer][data-vaul-drawer-direction='bottom']::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 0; right: 0; height: 200%; background: inherit; }

microDetails.rule: Jumping to an in-page anchor leaves 1rem of breathing room above the target.
microDetails.notes: web-interface-guidelines: scroll-margin-top on headings is a MUST.
